news.description: Our NFL Nation reporters react to all the action, answering the biggest questions coming out of each Sunday game. Here's what we learned from Week 11.

news.description: A closer look at the top 10 fantasy scorers in Week 11, including Cowboys QB Dak Prescott and Broncos RB Jonah Coleman.

news.headline: 49ers make bold statement with blowout win over Vikings, keep NFC's No. 1 seed
news.description: The 49ers used a late second-quarter burst to take control of Sunday's game in Mexico City and move to 9-1 on the season.

news.headline: Despite loss to Broncos, Fernando Mendoza settling in as Raiders' starting QB
news.description: Fernando Mendoza, making his second start for the Raiders, had good and bad moments Sunday at Denver. He completed 18 of 37 passes for 267 yards and three touchdowns but was sacked five times and pressured 16 times, and threw a game-sealing pick-six.

news.headline: Ja'Quan McMillian hoping long-term future is in Denver after latest clutch play
news.description: After Ja'Quan McMillian made a one-handed, 35-yard pick-six Sunday, his teammates surrounded him with a pay-the-man, count-that-money celebration.

news.headline: RB Cam Skattebo backflips again after pledging to nix celebration
news.description: Cam Skattebo's pledge to nix his trademark backflip didn't last long. Not even a week.

news.headline: Broncos coach Sean Payton awards game ball to Tom Jackson's family
news.description: The Broncos will send a game ball to the wife and daughters of Tom Jackson after the "Orange Crush" great died Friday at age 75.

news.headline: Inside Commanders DC Daronte Jones' unusual coaching journey
news.description: From living in his car to various college offices, Washington defensive coordinator Daronte Jones has paid his dues.

transactions.text: Signed LB Joe Bachie from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed C Seth McLaughlin and RB Jabari Small to the practice squad. Placed G Mason Miller on the practice squad/injured list.

Signed OLs Devin Cochran and Mason Miller, WRs Malik Cunningham and Jackson Meeks, DE Ahmed Hassanein, TE Zach Horton, RB Jabari Small, DL Chris Smith and S Loren Strickland to reserve/futures contracts. Re-signed OL Michael Niese, RB Jacob Saylors and CB Nick Whiteside.

insights: 2026 cap number of $248K is the 67th-largest on the roster.
Entered the league in 2025 as an undrafted free agent.
